title: Mechanical Avirtion
description: An integrated mod featuring create, aeronautics, terrain modification, and performance optimization
body:
# **✨「Mechanical Avirtion」**
- A lightweight mechanical power modpack designed for survival players! Focusing on the Create mod and Aeronautics system, it deeply integrates mechanical transmission, automated production lines, and aircraft extensions, complemented by streamlined and practical supplementary mods.
- 专为生存党打造的轻量级机械动力整合包！​核心聚焦机械动力（Create）与航空学（Aeronautics）模组，​深度整合机械传动、自动化产线及飞行载具扩展，​辅以精简实用的附属模组。
## **✨Key Features:**
- ✅ Ultra Smooth: Optimized for performance, runs seamlessly without lag on version 1.21.1
- ✅ Enhanced Exploration: New terrain generation + challenging dungeon remakes, making adventures more strategic
- ✅ Pure Experience: Removes redundant content, retaining only core mechanical/aviation/optimization mods
- ✅ 极致流畅：​经性能优化，​1.21.1版本运行丝滑无卡顿  
- ✅ 探索升级：​全新地形生成 + 挑战性地牢重制，​冒险更富策略  
- ✅ 纯粹体验：​剔除冗余内容，​仅保留核心机械/航空/优化类模组
